summary: End-to-end backend + frontend testing of the redesigned Hungry Birds web app. Admin all-orders + per-stall finances endpoints verified (10/10 pytest). Frontend covered: red/white login page, admin panel (all 6 tabs + orders filters + order detail sheet + finances money grid + stall approvals), Discover storefront with search/filters/6 stall cards, Offers page (balance + 2 wallets + how-it-works + empty coupons + 4 history filters), Orders list (in-progress + past), scroll-to-top on nav, mobile 390x844 with no overflow, no purple/violet colors.
critical_code_review_comments: list_all_orders at backend/app/modules/admin/router.py:122 does a full-table SELECT id, stall_name on vendors for every orders request to decorate stall_name. Fine for a handful of stalls, but should be joined (or cached) once Vendor rows grow.

AdminOrderOut inherits from OrderOut and relies on the subclass omitting delivery_code - verified in the response; if OrderOut later adds sensitive fields they will leak into the admin view too. Consider an explicit admin schema with only the fields you want.
No pagination/cursor on /api/admin/orders - only a 'days' + 'limit<=500' cap. Admins will outgrow this quickly.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@bitmesra.ac.in / HungryAdmin@2026. Student: student@bitmesra.ac.in via OTP (debug_code echoed in /api/auth/otp/request response in dev).
seed_data_creation: None - used existing seeded data (3 approved stalls, 1 pending 'Momo Junction', existing orders).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is FastAPI at /app/backend (not /app/backend/server.py shim). Admin login endpoint is POST /api/auth/admin/login (NOT /api/auth/password/login). Student login is OTP via /api/auth/otp/request + /api/auth/otp/verify (debug_code echoed in dev). Frontend stores tokens in localStorage keys hb_access_token / hb_refresh_token - handy to inject for authenticated UI tests when OTP endpoints are rate-limited by the UI's duplicate send. OTP endpoints ARE rate-limited per-IP (429 on repeated UI sends). Finance money grid test-ids are finance-cell-{dine-in|delivery|total}-{prepaid|cash|total}. Order list test-ids: admin-order-row-<id>, detail sheet admin-order-detail.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. The only minor hiccup during testing was an OTP 429 when the UI's send-code button was clicked right after an earlier run - mitigated by hitting /api/auth/otp/request + /verify directly and injecting the tokens into localStorage. All review-request assertions passed: admin orders list carries stall_name but no delivery_code; vendor finances returns 404 for unknown vendor and 403 for student token; dine-in cash cell is '—'; column and row totals in the money grid add up (dine-in 2615 + delivery 825 = total 3440; prepaid 3210 + cash 230 = total 3440); scroll-to-top returns scrollY=0 after every header-nav click; the entire palette is red/white/black with no purple/violet detected via computed-style sweep.
